subject.title: fix(agent): exit nonzero when gateway runs do not complete

question: Should `openclaw agent` treat every resolved gateway `cancelled` response as exit code 1 alongside timeout and error, or should cancellation retain a separately defined signal/exit convention?
rationale: The reported false-success behavior clearly covers timeout and resolved error, but extending the externally visible process-status change to cancellation is an intentional compatibility policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Accept unified non-success exits
options.body: Merge the branch with timeout, error, and cancelled gateway responses all producing exit code 1 after output, giving automation one simple terminal-failure contract.

options.title: Narrow to timeout and error
options.body: Keep the reported false-success repair while preserving existing cancellation behavior until a separate CLI cancellation contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept unified non-success exits
recommendation.body: Merge the branch with timeout, error, and cancelled gateway responses all producing exit code 1 after output, giving automation one simple terminal-failure contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They can provide implementation context, while a gateway/CLI code owner should make the compatibility decision.
